name: live-jazz
blurb: Told only “jazz”, Jev chose F major, 120 bpm and AABA, then walked ii–V–I in seventh chords and wrote a rest into the bridge.

name: live-bossa
blurb: Told “bossa nova”, Jev split 50/50 on the mode, took C minor, 88 bpm, and leaned the whole tune on dotted off-beat rhythms.

name: live-mood
blurb: “Wistful, late night”: minor at 100% confidence, 72 bpm, an all-minor i–iv–v, two long notes a bar.

name: demo-morning
blurb: “Bright and hopeful, a morning walk”: major at 100% confidence, 88 bpm, a 16-bar period rocking between C and F with one motif carried through.

name: demo-lullaby
blurb: “A lullaby, soft and slow”: 72 bpm at 100% confidence, the mode a 33% guess that landed on G minor, eight bars of half notes.

name: demo-fanfare
blurb: “Triumphant, a fanfare”: D major at 100%, 140 bpm; each bar's chord was decided just before its notes, and the tune opens with the fanfare leap A–D–F#.

name: demo-pop-loop
blurb: The four-chord pop loop C G Am F at 120; Jev writes a chorus over it, one arpeggiated motif per chord.

name: demo-wistful-loop
blurb: Am F C G at 92, told “wistful, looking back”: two long notes a bar, mostly chord tones.

name: demo-ii-v-i
blurb: Dm7 G7 Cmaj7 Cmaj7 at 132, told “jazz”: the tune breathes with rests and starts phrases off the beat.

name: demo-bossa-given
blurb: An eight-bar bossa progression in F with sevenths at 120; Jev writes a slow line of half notes over it, and a different one for the bridge.
